source: PixelLab character 5e05e92a (south-east rotation) animated with animate_image_pixminimax (11 clips + idle, seed 1); frames snapped to the 8-colour palette, specks < 12 px removed, feet on the bottom row (canvas rows 11..80). cast_gesture (9 frames, the Knight's timings) = X-slash take (job 66c2c370, first and last frame = the anchor): raw f0, f1, f2, f2, f3 (daggers raised above the shoulders, frame 4 = gesture_hold_frame, face clear), f4 (the two diagonal slashes crossing in a jade X, frame 5 = slash, 50 ms), f5, f6 (arms crossed low, follow-through), f8 (back to the guard). Replaced 2026-11-05 the crossed-X hold and the arms-flung-out take (user: 'xấu quá', wanted crossing slashes). hit = raw f3-f5 (f2 had a large blade smear). awaken = the held lunge raw f4-f8 (f3 smear dropped). fall = raw f5-f8 (arms up; the model turns toward the camera, no drop: the game moves the unit). draw and the dash clips are recentred on the head (x 46). step_back rejected (teleport with speed lines, cut at the canvas edge) and step_up not made: those steps play `step`. See design/assets/specs/assassin-assets.md. idle replaced 2026-11-05 by design/assets/candidates/assassin/anim-idle-v2 (PixMiniMax job 8ffc0f97, first and last frame pinned to the anchor, prompt from tessera_idle_animation_prompts.md movement part with positive wording; raw f0-f7, f8 = f0 dropped).

clips.name: idle
clips.note: 2026-11-16 Quill (weapon-free redesign, user 'Bỏ mũ'/'Nhận'): regenerated from the Quill anchor (character 5e05e92a, design/assets/candidates/assassin/quill-2026-11-15/rot/) with animate_character pixminimax, positive-only motion and the crouch pinned by geometry. Cleaned mechanically: snapped to the anchor's 6 colours, clusters under 12 px dropped, each frame replanted so its bottom row is 69, cropped 100x100 -> 96x70. Movement clips use the Swordsman v7 dash wording. 2026-11-16 sash removed (user 'Sua dai cheo'): at gameplay scale on the forest backdrop the long #BFF3EC diagonal across the chest read as a drawn blade on a weaponless character. Removed mechanically, no painting: the 8-connected clusters of that colour were found per frame and every cluster except the highest one (the hood edge around the face) was recoloured to the tunic dark #3A3744. 1686 px over 85 frames. Shape-independent, so crouched and leaning frames keep their hood edge.

clips.name: step_forward
clips.note: 2026-11-16 v7 dash, weaponless bodies (user 'Bam dat' / 'chot gen lai cho cac char con lai'). animate_image_pixminimax from the APPROVED weaponless anchor as BOTH first_frame_url and last_frame_url - pinning the last frame is what makes the clip return to the standing pose (the 2026-11-16 first attempt, pinned only at the start, flew off horizontally and never landed). Wording is swordsman-assets.md ASSET-001-DASH verbatim: knees bend, hips drop, chest tips at a SHALLOW angle (not 'far forward', which reads as a headfirst dive), hands trail BEHIND the hips with elbows pointing backward, holds ONE leaning shape unchanged for four frames - a dash has no stride - then plants, rises and finishes upright. No speed words. Every part stays inside the frame. step_up additionally states the SILHOUETTE WIDTH ('stays at least as wide as the first frame'), the clause that finally stopped the up clip turning into a back view on all four characters. Source frames 1,2,3,4,5,7,8 (anticipation, four held, brake, upright). Cleaned mechanically only: snapped to the unit's master-palette colours with tools/qa/sprite_clean.gd. 2026-11-16 sash removed (user 'Sua dai cheo'): at gameplay scale on the forest backdrop the long #BFF3EC diagonal across the chest read as a drawn blade on a weaponless character. frame_note: 2026-11-16: 70 -> 92. The Quill anchor is 63 px crouched, so every clip that lifts the body (lean-back, hit recoil, victory, fall) put pixels on row 0 of a 70-row frame — 16 frames across 7 clips, which the exporter refused. The Swordsman moved to 96x92 for the same reason. body_h stays 70 so the HUD and portraits keep framing the old body height; it is not a claim about the image.
